# Onedesk

OneDesk is an all-in-one platform combining help desk and project management functionalities, enabling teams to manage customer support and project tasks seamlessly.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/onedesk/.

## Actions

- **Create Worklog Entry**: Create a worklog entry.
- **Delete Attachment**: Delete a specific attachment.
- **Delete Comment**: Delete a specific comment by its id.
- **Delete Customer**: Delete a customer.
- **Delete Message**: Delete a specific message.
- **Delete Project**: Delete a project by its id.
- **Delete Requirement**: Delete a requirement.
- **Delete Task**: Delete a specific task.
- **Delete Ticket**: Delete a ticket by its id.
- **Delete Timesheet**: Delete a timesheet by its id.
- **Delete User**: Delete a user by its id.
- **Delete Worklog**: Delete a worklog by its id.
- **Get Attachments**: Retrieve a list of attachments.
- **Get Comment Details**: Retrieve detailed information for a comment by its id.
- **Get Comments**: Retrieve all comments.
- **Get Feedback Details**: Retrieve details of a specific feedback item.
- **Get Feedback Items**: Retrieve all feedback items.
- **Get Issue Details**: Retrieve details of a specific issue.
- **Get Issues**: Retrieve a list of issues.
- **Get Messages**: Retrieve a list of messages.
- **Get Requirement Details**: Retrieve full details of a specific requirement.
- **Get Requirements**: Retrieve a list of requirements.
- **Get Task Details**: Retrieve details of a specific task in onedesk.
- **Get Tickets**: Retrieve a list of tickets.
- **Get Timesheet Details**: Retrieve details of a specific timesheet entry.
- **Get Timesheets**: Retrieve a list of timesheet entries.
- **Get Worklog Details**: Retrieve details of a specific worklog.
- **Get Worklogs**: Retrieve all worklogs.
